content: 1. Every individual must adhere to the path ordained by Heaven, the Buddha, or the Gods. 2. Always demonstrate kindness and compassion toward others, and remain devoted to loving humanity. 3. The knowledge and teachings of medicine should be shared only with carefully selected individuals. 4. Do not disclose the medical treatments or teachings you have learned without explicit permission. 5. Avoid forming associations or professional relationships with physicians who are not part of this school. 6. All successors and descendants of the disciples of this school must strictly follow the teachings and practices of their instructors. 7. If a disciple ceases to practice medicine or if no successor is found upon their death, all medical texts and materials belonging to this school must be returned to the Enjuin School. 8. 9. The teaching or study of poisons is strictly forbidden within this school, and you must not seek instruction on poisons from other physicians. Additionally, you must not provide abortive substances to anyone. 10. You are obligated to treat and assist patients, even those you may personally dislike or harbor negative feelings toward. Acts of virtue should be performed discreetly, without seeking recognition or public acknowledgment, as true virtue lies in secrecy. 11. Do not exhibit greed or an excessive desire for wealth or fame. Never reprimand or criticize a patient, even if they fail to offer you money or gifts in gratitude for your services. 12. If a patient you have treated unsuccessfully is cured by another physician, you should feel joy and satisfaction rather than resentment. 13. Refrain from speaking negatively or disparagingly about other physicians. 14. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding anything you observe or learn when entering a woman’s room. Furthermore, you must not entertain any inappropriate or immoral thoughts during the examination of a female patient. 15. Whether appropriate or not, do not disclose the content of lectures or the knowledge you have gained about prescribing medicine to others. 16. Avoid indulgence in excessive luxury or extravagance, as such tendencies foster greed and diminish your capacity for kindness and compassion toward others. 17. Failure to adhere to the rules and regulations of this school will result in your expulsion as a disciple. In cases of severe violations, the consequences will be even more severe.
